messages:
deploy-bot: started helm upgrade for release=redwood-api chart=redwood/api image=redwood/api:v2.15.0 canary=10% env=prod-west preflight=Job(preflight-migrate) (ts:1789881234)

maya: preflight Job is stuck at 0/1 — pod Pending with message 'waiting for lock: schema-migrate'

sam: can confirm, kubectl logs preflight-migrate shows:
```
Waiting for exclusive lock: held by job redwood-api-migrate-2026-03-20-1
```

jordan: did we have a concurrent maintenance that could have grabbed the lock?

olivia: nothing scheduled that I see, lock contention probably from a flaky job retry earlier. Change window ends in ~2h.

maya: options: 1) wait (risk pushing past change window), 2) rollback, 3) skip preflight and continue.

sam: skipping preflight has risk but this is a schema-safe minor change; we've got compatibility shim for read paths. If we continue we'll limit canary to 5% and monitor closely.

release-coordinator: decision (thumbs): rollforward with preflight skipped. Pin chart version to 2.15.0, set canary to 5%, annotate release with rollout.redwood.com/skip-preflight=true, monitor 20m. Rollback if error rate > 2% or p95 latency regresses > 150ms.

deploy-bot: running helm upgrade now with override:
```
helm upgrade --install redwood-api ./charts/api \
  --version 2.15.0 \
  --set preflight.enabled=false \
  --set image.tag=v2.15.0 \
  --set canary.percent=5 \
  --wait --timeout 10m
```

maya: adding note to release notes: "Temporarily skipping migration job due to lock contention. Migration will be re-run during maintenance window and rolled forward if successful."

sam: applied k8s annotation: rollout.redwood.com/skip-preflight=true on deployment/redwood-api

jordan: created monitoring alerts: 1) logs.error rate, 2) latency p95 > 350ms, 3) DB 5xx > 1% — oncall @olivia

olivia: watching dashboards and logs :eyes:

deploy-bot: canary complete at 1789881550 — no alert triggers, error rate within baseline for 20m

maya: promoting canary to 100% in 5m

deploy-bot: promotion started

deploy-bot: upgrade completed at 1789881765 — release pinned to chart 2.15.0 with skip-preflight annotation

sam: post-deploy action item: schedule migration Job during maintenance window 2026-03-21 01:00 UTC, run it, then remove rollout.redwood.com/skip-preflight=true and verify schema version. I created an issue: https://redwood-internal/ops/issue/RED-3421

jordan: noted. tagging this thread for postmortem if migration fails.

maya: thanks all — documenting in release notes and change log. :white_check_mark:
